prompt: I need to create a comprehensive quarterly business review presentation for our SaaS company. The presentation should include: title slide with company branding, executive summary with key metrics, financial performance charts (revenue growth, churn rate, customer acquisition), product roadmap timeline, team highlights with photos, customer testimonials section, competitive analysis matrix, and closing slide with next steps. Use a professional dark theme with teal accents. Make it visually engaging with varied layouts - no boring bullet point slides. The data should show strong Q3 performance with 23% revenue growth, 2.1% monthly churn, and 450 new customers acquired.
